notes: Buildkite supplies the scheduler and the agent binary. The machine the agent runs on is the customer's, or a Buildkite-hosted agent. Buildkite's own limits table gives the Free plan 2,000 Linux vCPU-minutes of hosted agents and 20 vCPU of concurrency. Its Linux hosted-agent page restricts the Free plan to the small 2 vCPU / 4 GB / 47 GB shape. So Buildkite does sell a free machine: 2 vCPU and 4 GB, with no card. The pool is measured against a 2 vCPU agent, because a Free-plan namespace cannot select a 4 vCPU one. At 2 vCPU the pool is 16 h 40 min a month. At 4 vCPU it would be 8 h 20 min, and that figure does not apply here. Not established: the egress term; whether a hosted agent can be reached inbound, since no page read says it can and the environment is destroyed at job end; and whether the 2,000 vCPU-minutes includes the boot time of the agent, because the limits page says booting consumes concurrency but does not say whether it consumes minutes.

superseded.notes: Recorded for completeness and as a contrast: this provider is a scheduler, not a machine, which is exactly the distinction this assignment is meant to draw. Judge it on the machine it provides, and it provides none. The vCPU-minute unit is the reason the headline 2,000 looks larger than it is: a reader who takes it for minutes of a machine overstates it by the core count.

shape.note: `LINUX_AMD64_2X4`, the only shape the Free plan offers, quoted as 'Small | AMD64 | 2 | 4 GB | 47 GB'. The vendor writes decimal GB; kept unconverted, so 4 GB is about 3.7 GiB and 47 GB about 43.8 GiB. Larger shapes exist (4/16/95, 8/32/158 and up to 64 vCPU) but are paid-plan or Enterprise only.

extras.price_arithmetic: 2,000 vCPU-minutes / 2 vCPU = 1,000 wall-clock minutes = 16 h 40 min a month at USD 0.00. 10 h a day x 30 = 300 h = 18,000 wall-clock minutes = 36,000 vCPU-minutes, eighteen times the pool. 24/7 x 30 = 730 h needs 87,600 vCPU-minutes, forty-four times the pool. Past the pool the rate is USD 0.004 per vCPU-minute on a paid platform plan, so 36,000 vCPU-minutes would be USD 144.00 and 87,600 USD 350.40.
